title: RouteModule
summary: The data and rendering exports belonging to a route.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: The data and rendering exports belonging to a route. loader/action are server handlers with transport; clientLoader/clientAction are browser handlers. Rendering uses default, HydrateFallback, and ErrorBoundary. A manual browser table executes functions locally unless serverRoute supplies proxies.
sections.code:
import * as module from "./routes/tasks/route";
const route = defineRoute("/tasks", module);
